overview.description: The MicroSectors Travel - 3x Inverse Leveraged ETN (FLYD) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the MerQube MicroSectors U.S. Travel index. The fund tracks 300% inverse of the daily price movements of a liquidity-weighted index of US-listed travel-related companies. FLYD was launched on Jun 24, 2022 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
